title: PM shares a Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting the path to supreme spiritual attainment
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, has shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam reflecting on the core virtues - study, penance, wisdom, self-restraint, non-violence, and service to the Guru - that lead to the highest spiritual welfare. The Prime Minister posted on X: "विद्याभ्यासस्तपो ज्ञानमिन्द्रियाणां च संयमः। अहिंसा गुरुसेवा च निःश्रेयसकरं परम्॥" विद्याभ्यासस्तपो ज्ञानमिन्द्रियाणां च संयमः।

 अहिंसा गुरुसेवा च निःश्रेयसकरं परम्॥ https://t.co/EoexRyMsTm — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) November 25, 2026 **** MJPS/SS/VJ/SS
